notes:
### 新功能

- 二维码工具新增「识别」：可以选图片、把图片拖进来、Ctrl+V 粘贴，也能从剪贴板（包括记忆长廊里最近的一张图）或整个屏幕识别，一张图里有几个码都能认出来，歪的、斜着拍的、反色的也能认。
- 识别后按内容给出操作：网址会先问要不要打开，并提示没加密、仿冒域名、短链、会下载程序这类风险；Wi‑Fi 码可以一键连接；名片存成 .vcf、日程存成 .ics；两步验证码直接显示当前验证码；收付款码提示用手机扫码。
- 工具工坊新增「🎭 模拟大师」，造测试数据和测试文件：
- 数据：设计字段（姓名、手机号、带正确校验位的身份证号和银行卡号、按正则生成、嵌套对象等 70 多种），或套用内置模板、从样例 JSON 或字段名自动推断，输出 JSON、CSV、SQL、Excel 等十种格式，按行数或按文件大小生成；文字直接进剪贴板，文件直接存到磁盘。
- 文本：指定长度的文字（按字符数或字节数），以及常用的边界测试字符串。
- 文件：txt、日志、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、各种图片、音频、视频、ZIP、任意大小的占位文件等，大多能精确到指定的字节数，可以批量生成，也能照着一个样本文件造。
- 随手取：身份证、手机号、银行卡等常用值，点一下拿一个，也能一次复制一批。

### 改进

- JSON 查看器的树形列表隔行换色，并用竖线把同一层级的节点连起来，层级一眼看得清。

### New

- The QR code tool can now scan: choose images, drop them in, press Ctrl+V, or scan the clipboard (including the latest image in Memory Gallery) or the whole screen. Every code in a picture is found, even rotated, photographed at an angle or inverted.
- Results come with actions: links ask before opening and warn about unencrypted, look-alike, shortened or download links; Wi‑Fi codes connect in one click; contacts save as .vcf and events as .ics; two-factor codes show the current code; payment codes tell you to scan them with your phone.
- New “🎭 Mock Master” tool in the Workshop for test data and test files:
- Data: design fields (names, phone numbers, ID and bank card numbers with valid check digits, regex patterns, nested objects and 70+ more), or start from a template or infer them from a sample JSON or field names; output JSON, CSV, SQL, Excel and six more formats, by row count or by file size; text goes straight to the clipboard and files straight to disk.
- Text: text of an exact length (in characters or bytes) and common edge-case test strings.
- Files: txt, logs, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, audio, video, ZIP, instant placeholder files of any size and more, most of them exact to the byte, in batches, or modeled on a sample file.
- Quick pick: common values such as ID, phone and bank card numbers, one click for one or a whole batch.

### Improvements

- The JSON Viewer tree now has alternating row colors and vertical lines linking nodes on the same level, so the structure is easy to follow.
